entities.summary: Tell al-Rimah is an archaeological settlement mound, in Nineveh Province, Iraq, roughly 80 kilometres (50 mi) west of Mosul and ancient Nineveh in the Sinjar region. It lies 15 kilometers south of the site of Tal Afar.
